item.title: How to Check if an Object Has a Property in JavaScript
item.description: Checking if an object has a specific property is crucial for defensive programming and avoiding runtime errors when accessing object properties. As the creator of CoreUI, I regularly validate object properties when processing API responses and user configurations. The most reliable method is using Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty() or the modern Object.hasOwn() method, which check for own properties without inherited ones.
